We are seeking a skilled and passionate Machine Learning Engineer to serve as the steward of our inference engine, a core open-source and commercial computer vision inference platform. This role is critical in scaling our inference capabilities by building an automated, agentic-driven contribution and release pipeline. The ideal candidate will focus on enhancing the quality, reliability, and speed of our releases, aiming to transition from weekly to daily deployment cycles. You will lead efforts to develop comprehensive testing suites, define review standards, and streamline the process of integrating new models into our system. Additionally, you will act as a bridge between engineering and clients, translating technical capabilities into accessible documentation, demos, and stories. Your work will directly impact how thousands of developers and organizations leverage computer vision technology globally.

Expertise in image and video processing tools like OpenCV, DeepStream, Pillow, and related protocols
Solid background in systems programming, architecture, and reliability engineering
Experience with open source project stewardship and community engagement
Excellent communication skills, capable of teaching and collaborating across teams and with external audiences
Familiarity with AI coding agents and their integration into engineering workflows is a plus

Simplify and accelerate the process of integrating new models into the inference system
Educate internal teams and customers on maximizing inference capabilities through documentation, demos, and support
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to communicate new features and capabilities effectively
Contribute to and grow the open-source community surrounding the inference project
Lead efforts to automate and improve release processes, ensuring reliability and speed
